authority.scope: Minimal canonical ordering only. Historical contracts, pilots, calibration runs and receipts remain provenance unless explicitly required below.
superseded: The former five-stage source/measurement/assessability/ecology/synthesis surface is simplified to source -> measurement_qc -> ecology -> output.
Assessability is reduced to simple measurement completion/missingness accounting inside measurement_qc; it is not a separate environmental analysis.
Versioned alternative colour definitions, model-specific environment diagnostics and dependence-calibration expansions are supporting technical work, not canonical gates.
Optional breadth/hypervolume synthesis is outside the canonical path.
Historical acquisition, pilot, repair and exploratory receipts remain unchanged and cannot alter primary route admission.
authority.entrypoint_scope: Integrity and readiness reporting only; cannot authorize image production or ecological fitting.

stages.question: Which records support the native-range ecological question?
stages.output: Frozen native source view with dates, photo links and known dependence preserved.

stages.question: Have the frozen image measurements been recovered, integrated and reduced to fixed primary module representations with explicit missingness?
stages.output: All 27 raw endpoints retained; existing QC applied; completed/pending/blocked measurements counted; orientation, visible-colour and gross-shape representations fixed before ecology.

stages.question: Using the fixed measured cohorts and existing model, what are the within-taxon, among-taxon and scale-contrast associations?
stages.output: The already-declared ecological model is run once on the fixed module cohorts, with effect sizes and uncertainty. No rescue analysis is added.

stages.question: Can the canonical results be rendered without changing the scientific analysis?
stages.output: Figures, tables, manuscript-facing summaries and reproducibility records generated from canonical results.

source_and_sampling.native_limit: Authority-backed regional membership; unresolved records remain in the master source.
source_and_sampling.analysis_unit: observation, retaining shared-photo and known exact-content dependence across observations
source_and_sampling.coverage_rule: Measurement/QC records only the counts and endpoint/module missingness needed to define the realized analysis cohorts. It does not create a separate taxon-by-region-by-environment research program.
source_and_sampling.sampling_limit: The workflow cannot recover unrecorded plants or an unbiased occurrence-effort surface.

environment_and_inference.formulation_rule: Use the one already-frozen additive conditional environment model for every primary module; do not select predictors from v3 trait results.
environment_and_inference.temporal_target: Observation-month 1981-2010 climatology plus retained annual/seasonal context; none is event weather or direct head exposure.
environment_and_inference.environment_missingness: Use the frozen retained predictors and declare the realized complete model membership. No imputation, silent row deletion or outcome-driven reselection.
environment_and_inference.nuisance: Use the already-frozen calendar, image-quality and spherical-basis nuisance design.
environment_and_inference.within: Use the already-implemented covariance-aware partially pooled taxon model.
environment_and_inference.among: Use one matched phenotype/exposure summary per taxon on the same eligible support.
environment_and_inference.common_scale: Use the same saved response/predictor transformation when comparing within and among effects.
environment_and_inference.scale_contrast: Estimate among minus within on matched eligible taxa/support.
environment_and_inference.primary_probability_family: If probabilities are reported, retain the already-declared 3 modules x 4 process blocks x 3 questions = 36-slot family.
environment_and_inference.secondary_only: Endpoint decompositions, calibration runs, influence summaries and exploratory all-27 results are supporting material only and cannot rescue or redefine the primary result.
environment_and_inference.phylogeny: Legacy phylogenetic placement is not a canonical control or independent confirmation.
environment_and_inference.functional_form: Primary association remains linear over observed support; no new nonlinear or interaction family is added in this revision.

trait_representation.primary_module_geometry: Use the existing frozen orientation=1, visible_colour=8 and gross_shape=4 coordinate representation.
trait_representation.hue: Treat sine and cosine jointly as one circular quantity.
trait_representation.composition: Treat the four colour fractions as one closed composition using the existing joint Hellinger representation.
trait_representation.correlation: Endpoint correlation may be summarized for redundancy/QC interpretation, but it is not a data-driven endpoint-selection rule.
trait_representation.chroma_revision: Continue using the registered legacy chroma in the canonical workflow. The uniform-floral candidate remains noncanonical technical work and is not a gate.
trait_representation.uncertainty: BBox and photometric perturbations describe technical sensitivity, not physical trait accuracy.

hypervolume.failure_rule: Hypervolume/breadth work cannot block ecology or output.

two_contributions.methodological: A reproducible source-to-image-measurement workflow that retains the 27-endpoint record and makes the primary module representation explicit.
two_contributions.ecological: Estimate the already-declared module-specific abiotic associations across within- and among-taxon scales.
limits: image variation is not biological variance alone
